lines.en: Hey, guys, what should I wear to a Knicks game?
Uh, a T-shirt that says, "I don't belong here."
You have Knicks tickets?
Yeah, my mom got my dad's season tickets
and the divorce, so she just gave them to me.
Yeah. Apparently, they're-- they're pretty good seats.
Oh, my God! Those are almost right on the floor!
Do you guys want these?
- Yeah, we do! - Yeah, we do!
- Oh, well, you got 'em! - All right!
Just give us our apartment back.
- - Oh, I didn't see that coming.
- Are you serious? - Oh, come on.
We know what these are worth.
What, do you think we're stupid?
Not stupid. You're meaner than I thought.
- What do you say? - Forget it, okay?
I'm not giving up my bachelor pad for some basketball seats.
Your bachelor pad?
Have you even had a girl up here?
- No. -
But, uh, Joey has,
and I usually talk to them in the morning time.
Yeah, you do.
